headline: WSN @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 3.72 at CLE 3.72, with a projected total of 7.44. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: WSN moved -0.87 runs while CLE moved -1.84, changing the projected margin by +0.97 runs. The projected total fell -2.70, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Joey Cantillo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for James Wood, Travis Bazzana, Daylen Lile, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags José Tena, Chase DeLauter because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
